question: Should Oracle upgrades intentionally change shared-profile browser execution from three concurrent tabs with a finite wait to one serialized tab with unlimited queue waiting?
rationale: The fairness fix does not inherently require either default change, and both alter existing operator-visible throughput and failure behavior.

options.title: Preserve shipped defaults
options.body: Keep maxConcurrentTabs at 3 and use a finite queue timeout by default, while allowing users to opt into one-tab serialization or unlimited waits explicitly.

options.title: Adopt serialized defaults
options.body: Ship maxConcurrentTabs 1 and queueTimeoutMs 0 only as an explicitly approved compatibility change with upgrade documentation and inspectable long-run proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve shipped defaults
recommendation.body: Keep maxConcurrentTabs at 3 and use a finite queue timeout by default, while allowing users to opt into one-tab serialization or unlimited waits explicitly.
